# Command flags

<!-- Generated by `go run ./scripts/docsgen` from the command table. Do not edit by hand. -->

Every command and flag, exactly as `pandora help` and `pandora <command> -h` print them. For what each command does, see the [command-line guide](cli.md).

```text
Usage: pandora [command]

Without a command Pandora opens the interactive interface.

Commands:
  list        List secrets (metadata only)
  expiring    List expired and expiring secrets (exit 3 if any)
  get         Print a secret's value
  history     List the previous values of a secret (dates only, never values)
  restore     Make a previous value of a secret current again
  log         Show the audit log (needs audit_log in config.json)
  add         Add a secret (value from stdin or a hidden prompt)
  rm          Delete a secret
  run         Run a command with secrets injected as environment variables
  env         Print secrets as KEY=value dotenv lines
  export      Export metadata, or encrypted metadata and values
  import      Import a Pandora export, a dotenv file or a Bitwarden JSON export
  id          Print this vault's share key (give it to the machines that send you secrets)
  peer        Manage the vaults trusted to share secrets with this one (add, list, rm)
  doctor      Check the vault files and the keyring values
  passwd      Change the master password (--rotate-key also replaces the data key)
  gen         Generate random secrets (printed to stdout, not stored)
  config      Show the config file path or the effective settings
  version     Print version information (also --version)
  completion  Print a shell completion script (bash, zsh, fish, powershell)
  help        Show this help

Run 'pandora <command> -h' for the flags of a command.
```

## `pandora list`

```text
Usage: pandora list [--category C] [--tag T] [--json]
  -c string
    	shorthand for --category
  -category string
    	only secrets in this category (case-insensitive)
  -json
    	print JSON instead of a table
  -t value
    	shorthand for --tag
  -tag value
    	only secrets with this tag; repeat or comma-separate to require several
```

## `pandora expiring`

```text
Usage: pandora expiring [--within 14d] [--json]
  -json
    	print JSON instead of a table
  -within string
    	window in days, e.g. 14d (default expiry_warn_days from the config file, 14)
```

## `pandora get`

```text
Usage: pandora get <title> [-q] [--newline=false] [--copy] [--version -1]
  -copy
    	copy the value to the clipboard instead of printing it
  -newline
    	print a trailing newline (default true)
  -q	no trailing newline (same as --newline=false)
  -version int
    	0 is the current value; -1 the previous one, -2 the one before (see 'pandora history')
```

## `pandora history`

```text
Usage: pandora history <title> [--json]
  -json
    	print JSON instead of a table
```

## `pandora restore`

```text
Usage: pandora restore <title> [--version -1]
  -version int
    	which previous value: -1 is the latest, -2 the one before (default -1)
```

## `pandora log`

```text
Usage: pandora log [--since 7d|12h|YYYY-MM-DD] [--json]
  -json
    	print JSON instead of a table
  -since string
    	only entries from this far back (7d, 12h) or from this date (YYYY-MM-DD)
```

## `pandora add`

```text
Usage: pandora add <title> [-c CATEGORY] [-u USERNAME] [--tag TAG] [--notes TEXT] [--expires YYYY-MM-DD]
  -c string
    	category
  -category string
    	category
  -expires string
    	expiry date, YYYY-MM-DD
  -notes string
    	free-form notes
  -t value
    	tag; repeat or comma-separate for several
  -tag value
    	tag; repeat or comma-separate for several
  -u string
    	user name / login
  -username string
    	user name / login
```

## `pandora rm`

```text
Usage: pandora rm <title> [-y]
  -y	delete without asking
  -yes
    	delete without asking
```

## `pandora run`

```text
Usage: pandora run -s TITLE[=ENV_NAME] [-s ...] -- command [args...]
  -s TITLE[=ENV_NAME]
    	secret to inject, TITLE[=ENV_NAME]; ENV_NAME defaults to the title upper-cased with other characters as _ (repeatable)
  -secret value
    	same as -s
```

## `pandora env`

```text
Usage: pandora env -s TITLE[=ENV_NAME] [-s ...] [--force]
  -force
    	print values even when stdout is a terminal
  -s TITLE[=ENV_NAME]
    	secret to print, TITLE[=ENV_NAME]; ENV_NAME defaults to the title upper-cased with other characters as _ (repeatable)
  -secret value
    	same as -s
```

## `pandora export`

```text
Usage: pandora export [--values] [--to PEER ...] [-s TITLE ...] [-o FILE] [--force]
  -force
    	overwrite an existing output file
  -o FILE
    	write to FILE instead of stdout
  -output FILE
    	write to FILE instead of stdout
  -s value
    	export only this secret (repeatable)
  -secret value
    	same as -s
  -to value
    	encrypt for this trusted peer instead of a passphrase; needs --values (repeatable)
  -values
    	include secret values; the output is then encrypted with a passphrase (prompted twice, or from PANDORA_PASSPHRASE)
```

## `pandora import`

```text
Usage: pandora import FILE [--format FORMAT] [--values] [--overwrite] [--dry-run] [--category C]
  -category string
    	with --format dotenv: category for every imported secret
  -dry-run
    	list what would be imported, replaced and skipped, and change nothing
  -format string
    	format of FILE: pandora, dotenv, bitwarden-json (default "pandora")
  -overwrite
    	replace secrets that already exist instead of skipping them
  -values
    	restore the values in an encrypted Pandora export or a share made with --to
```

## `pandora id`

```text
Usage: pandora id
```

## `pandora peer`

```text
Usage: pandora peer add NAME KEY|KEYFILE [-y] | peer list [--json] | peer rm NAME [-y]
  -json
    	with list, print JSON
  -y	with add or rm, do not ask
  -yes
    	with add or rm, do not ask
```

## `pandora doctor`

```text
Usage: pandora doctor [--fix] [-y]
  -fix
    	repair: restore a damaged vault.json from vault.json.bak, and remove metadata entries whose value is missing
  -y	with --fix, repair without asking
  -yes
    	with --fix, repair without asking
```

## `pandora passwd`

```text
Usage: pandora passwd [--rotate-key]
  -rotate-key
    	also replace the data key and re-encrypt every value
```

## `pandora gen`

```text
Usage: pandora gen [--length N] [--charset alnum|symbols|hex] [--count N]
  -charset string
    	alphabet: alnum, symbols, hex (default "alnum")
  -count int
    	how many secrets to print, 1 to 100 (default 1)
  -length int
    	length of each secret, 8 to 128 (default 24)
```

```text
Usage: pandora config path | config get [KEY]
```
